nodes.description: Owner address state variable of Ownable; source of privileged authorization.
Ownable constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment.
onlyOwner modifier; requires msg.sender to equal the stored owner.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner; updates owner.
New owner address supplied to transferOwnership.
msg.sender used for ownership assignment and authorization checks.
Indorser.multisend; batch-transfers tokens via an external Token contract call in a loop.
Token contract address argument used as the external call target.
Array of recipient addresses passed to the external transfer call.
Array of transfer amounts passed to the external transfer call.
uint8 loop counter indexing the _to and _value arrays.
External call Token(_tokenAddr).transfer(_to[i], _value[i]) executed inside the loop; state/control resumes after untrusted callee returns.
uint8 loop counter increment i++ (unchecked arithmetic in a tight loop).
require(msg.sender == owner) authorization gate in onlyOwner.
External Token interface function transfer(address to, uint value) returns (bool).

edges.reason: Constructor writes owner from msg.sender, tying ownership to the caller identity.
msg.sender is compared against stored owner in the require check, controlling privileged access.
Ownable constructor initializes the owner state variable.
newOwner parameter overwrites the privileged owner state variable.
newOwner flows into the privileged owner = newOwner state change operation.
onlyOwner modifier gates entry into transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier body executes the require(msg.sender == owner) authorization check.
Authorization check must pass before the privileged owner state change executes.
User-supplied _tokenAddr determines the address of the external contract being called.
Recipient list _to flows into the external transfer call, which hands control to an untrusted token contract.
Amount array _value flows into the external transfer call arguments.
Loop counter i indexes _to[i] and _value[i] for each external transfer invocation.
Loop counter i is incremented by i++ arithmetic each iteration.
multisend loop body executes the external call to the Token contract before the loop completes.
multisend invokes the external Token.transfer interface function.
The untrusted token contract called via Token(_tokenAddr).transfer can re-enter multisend while the loop state is incomplete.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a transient argument that is immediately consumed by the privileged owner = newOwner write; it has no independent semantic role beyond that operation.
_tokenAddr exists only to designate the callee of the external transfer call and should be folded into that unsafe operation.
_to is a temporary input array consumed solely as recipients of the external transfer call in each loop iteration.
_value is a temporary input array consumed solely as amounts of the external transfer call in each loop iteration.
Local loop counter i is a short-lived index whose only algorithmic effect is the i++ increment driving the loop.
